gloss: nursing care leave; family care leave

definitions.gloss: nursing care leave; family care leave
definitions.explanation: leave from work to care for a family member who needs nursing care

examples.japanese: {親|おや}の{介護|かいご}のために{介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I took nursing care leave to care for my parent.

examples.japanese: {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}は{年間|ねんかん}5{日|にち}{取得|しゅとく}できる。
examples.english: You can take 5 days of nursing care leave per year.

examples.japanese: {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}と{介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}は{別|べつ}の{制度|せいど}だ。
examples.english: Nursing care leave and nursing care leave of absence are different systems.

notes:
CARE LEAVE VOCABULARY:
{介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} is leave taken to care for family members who need nursing care.

TWO TYPES OF CARE LEAVE:
- {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} - short-term care leave (typically up to 5 days per year)
- {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう} - long-term care leave (up to 93 days total)

CULTURAL NOTE:
As Japan's population ages, {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} has become increasingly important. The law allows employees to take leave to care for:
- Parents
- Spouse
- Children
- Other family members needing care
{介護離職|かいごりしょく} (leaving work due to care responsibilities) is a growing social issue, which is why the government promotes {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} and {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}.

RELATED WORDS:
- {介護|かいご} - nursing care
- {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう} - nursing care leave of absence
- {介護離職|かいごりしょく} - leaving work for caregiving
- {育休|いくきゅう} - childcare leave
